findings.title: Proceeds from Vehicle Disposals has no plan data
findings.detail: Referenced by Cash Flow from Investing Activities but evaluates to 0 in every version.
findings.prompt: Proceeds from Vehicle Disposals (cf-disposals) has no data. Should it stay in the Cash Flow from Investing Activities formula, and how should it be planned (driver, % of another line, or ML forecast)?

findings.title: Add Overheads % of Revenue
findings.detail: Overheads has no ratio KPI — common in EPM reporting packs.
findings.prompt: Add a new KPI "Overheads % of Revenue" = opex-excl / rev * 100.

findings.prompt: Add a new KPI "Profit Before Tax % of Revenue" = ebt / rev * 100.

findings.title: Gross Revenue (Transport, Forwarding, Customs, Logistics & Fuel Surcharge) moved EUR -514M vs Budget
findings.detail: Largest Q3 Forecast vs Budget movement among P&L inputs.
findings.prompt: Explain the EUR -514M movement in Gross Revenue (Transport, Forwarding, Customs, Logistics & Fuel Surcharge) between Budget and Q3 Forecast and its impact through to EBITDA and Net Income.
